mandatory_objectives: Treat the pinned r02-input-bindings issue within the selected R02 surface.
Restore the PRD's default shoulder-switch behavior as one bounded player step.
Preserve the existing complete Ranger, authored village, unarmed initialization, equipment ownership gates and working locomotion.
Preserve both frozen technical baselines and leave full product acceptance unchanged.
task_specification.objective: Repair default shoulder-switch ownership in the frozen loop-02 candidate: Tab switches shoulders during ordinary unarmed exploration, E stops switching shoulders, and the visible shoulder prompt reflects Tab.

diagnosis.root_cause: The adopted demo's input dispatch still assigns E directly to shoulder switching, and its help label repeats that assignment. PRD section 3.2 assigns Tab to shoulder switching and reserves E for interaction. Prior Tester observations independently showed Tab leaving shoulder_side unchanged while E changed it. Rolling and remapping have separate outstanding acceptance within the same issue; the present budget supports one observable shoulder-switch repair.

stop_conditions: Stop expansion after the single shoulder-switch increment; report remaining issue acceptance as unfinished.
If ordinary input, authoritative shoulder/orientation state or representative runtime frames cannot be captured, report insufficient evidence and leave acceptance pending.
If a technical baseline or preserved movement/equipment behavior regresses, repair that regression before reporting the increment complete.
Do not claim issue closure, R02 passage or milestone passage from source changes or Developer self-validation.

strategy.rationale: Address the directly reproduced input-dispatch defect instead of repeating the prior map/actor integration strategy. The one-condition budget is used for a single camera action, with its necessary reserved-key and prompt corrections. Existing camera geometry, animations and assets remain qualified dependencies rather than additional work surfaces.

code: Inspect shoulder input dispatch and help text together: Tab owns shoulder switching, E has no shoulder-switch path, and key echo cannot repeat the switch.
Confirm changes preserve the existing camera behavior, equipment initialization and locomotion interfaces.
Run the required native_godot_project and host_godot_boot checks against the resulting candidate.
runtime: Host/Tester capture the settled unarmed start, one physical Tab press, key release and a second distinct Tab press. Observe shoulder_side changing once per press and returning after the second press while world-facing direction remains unchanged.
Press E on the same exploration surface and confirm shoulder_side remains unchanged; do not count absent interaction content as implemented interaction behavior.
Check adjacent ordinary walking, mouse look and existing cursor-release/reacquisition behavior for input regressions.

Host/Tester retain the full required QA cadence and frozen milestone_01_r02_player_locomotion_contract review. Report remaining failed, unverified and unavailable observations separately; the local condition cannot substitute for that review.
visual: Capture ordinary game views before switching and after each shoulder settles, showing the complete unarmed Ranger and the opposite camera placement.
Inspect the visible shoulder prompt for Tab and readable agreement with the actual default input.
Compare preserved actor appearance and equipment visibility with the current candidate baseline; no asset replacement is part of this repair.

done_when: During ordinary unarmed exploration, one Tab press switches the camera to the opposite shoulder without changing the player's world-facing direction.
tasks.instructions: Use the frozen candidate a800549cea911d421d9a0c120cea477f6e59e5d711eeee6b50cedb262236e5f3 and PRD section 3.2. Reproduce the prior Tab/E shoulder observation, then repair the default shoulder-switch input and its visible help text. Tab must invoke the existing shoulder behavior once per press; E must cease invoking that behavior. Preserve world orientation and the existing shoulder interpolation. Keep the implementation choice open and restrict edits to input ownership and the related prompt. Preserve pre-tree-entry unarmed configuration, all equipment gates, complete head/rig/material bindings, advancing Idle/Walk playback, terrain support and observed traversal recovery. Do not broaden this task into rolling, remapping UI, new interaction/lamp mechanics or deferred presentation repairs. The sole done_when is partial progress against R02, not replacement acceptance: retain the complete issue and frozen quality checks. Developer performs focused self-validation; Host and Tester own independent recapture, formal review and closure.

investigation.expected_observation: Before repair, E changes shoulder_side while Tab does not. After repair, a Tab press changes its sign once, release/hold produces no extra switch, and E leaves shoulder_side unchanged; world-facing direction remains stable.
investigation.hypothesis: The shoulder failure is caused by the inherited hard-coded E dispatch, rather than camera transforms or animation bindings.
investigation.probe: On the same settled unarmed scene, exercise physical Tab and E separately and compare shoulder_side, camera yaw and visible camera placement before and after each input, including key release.

research_assessment.reason: The inspected candidate dispatch and prior independent measurements identify the exact key-ownership defect. This bounded repair does not select a new controller mechanism or resource.

resource_strategy.reason: This increment changes existing key dispatch and its help label only; it delivers no new or rebound map, actor, animation or visual resource.

risk_note.summary: A screenshot alone may miss the shoulder transition or conceal repeated dispatch, leaving the completion condition insufficiently evidenced.
risk_note.validation: Pair physical press/release actions with before/after authoritative shoulder and orientation values and settled runtime frames. If those observations are unavailable, retain the incomplete verdict.
risk_note.why_now: The prior input failure was reproduced, but current Planner runtime control is unavailable and review_r02 is a qualitative, non-executable scenario.
